_doc: Combat engine constants, the one source for both engines (ADR-0001 Implementation Guidelines). Read by tools/design/combat_sim/engine.py and src/gameplay/combat/fight/combat_constants.gd. K: Combat GDD constants (seconds unless named otherwise); U: per-realm unit; SUPP: realm suppression by realm gap (Formulas H); BLOCK_UNIT: block points to health per realm. health_units / qi_units: health_max = health_units x U x n_body x health_mult x d_r and qi_base = qi_units x U x n_qi; cost_red_cap and reserve_cap cap those shares; pay_keep_health: an art paid in health must leave this much; min_hit: a hit that reaches health removes at least this. BUFF / DEBUFF: per element, the stat each stack of an element buff or debuff adds (Effects rule 9a, #44). STATUS: the Status Catalogue (Effects GDD): kind tick or curse, damage type and c_tick for ticks, dur in pulses (null = until cleansed), cap (null = none) and each curse's numbers. TICK_TYPE: the damage type of an element debuff's tick. ELEM_TYPE: an elem art's usual damage type by element. status_chance_min / status_chance_max: a status chance below 1, or any chance against status resistance, is clamped to this range (Combat Formulas F). purity_stack_power: each point of an element's purity adds this to its stacks' power (Spiritual Roots rule 8a, Formulas H); water_ice_share: Water and Ice count this share of each other's purity. cleanse_min_stacks: after the cleansing ward's share, a debuff batch below this many stacks is gone. EVENTS / MOD_KEYS / ACTIONS: the Effect vocabulary both engines accept (Effects GDD rules 5-6); a record using anything else stops the load. trig_floor_u: trigger damage budget floor, in U (Combat Formulas G: budget = trig_budget x max(direct damage, trig_floor_u x U)). delay_falloff: each delay a fighter took within delay_window multiplies the next by this (R1). summon_c / summon_for: a summon's coefficient and seconds when its Effect gives none. injury_every: seconds between Internal Injury releases when none is given. refuse_down_health: the health a refused Down leaves (Effects rule 11). CHARACTER_MODS: how a Character's stat-sheet modifier keys reach a fight (FighterCompiler and fight.py, user decision 2026-11-14). passive: key -> [engine mod key, factor], the mod is value x factor; ctx_mods: engine mods read per hit, so a scoped line keeps its scope (others apply to every art and are reported); out_of_fight: keys with no part in a fight, skipped silently; static: keys folded into the fighter itself (pools, body shield, ward strength and efficiency, divine sense, stack effect and duration) rather than a live mod; scope_element / scope_dtype: a scope tag that names an element (Hán-Việt id -> engine element) or a damage type (GDD tag -> engine dtype). Down step events (Effects rule 11): "down" is Down step 2 (a side going Down; refusal records listening to it are step 1 and are read by the step itself), "refused" is raised after a refusal saves the side. STATUS stacking "none" (the catalogue's Stacking None: Corpse Rot, Sealed Meridian, Silence): a recast while the status runs does nothing (Effects Edge Cases, rule 9). Đạo Đồ Effects vocabulary (2026-11-20, ADR-0004 decision 3): events blocked (a hit's block stopped part of it; amount = the part blocked), buff_gained (own buff stacks gained), batch_ended (one of your stack batches ran out on its own; element, stacks, kind, rekindled); mod flags (on when > 0) no_block, ignore_block, no_evade, no_body_shield, speed_locked, delay_immune, no_gain_on_hit, sure_crit, status_immune (status filter), reflect_first, counted_crit; mod values ward_pct (live ward strength %), stack_more (share, own buff stacks, element filter), shield_hold (share on every body-shield bar and gain), overheat (cap in L5 points), crit_cap_to (a lower crit cap); action return_damage. EVENT_ALIAS (world-depth Stage 5, 2026-11-26): Effects GDD names an engine event by another word; both engines read an Effect's `on` through it at load (batch_expired is batch_ended, healed is heal_restored). Statuses of 2026-11-26 (world-depth Stage 5 slice 2a; Effects Status Catalogue): off_guard (evade counts as 0, no draw), bound (escape fails while it holds; escape is not built yet), charmed (holds its arts; held caster; a direct hit by its caster ends it, companions excepted), drunk (each stack its own timer: stack_timers; per stack slow and acc_down, water_taken at water_taken_at stacks), sleep (clock_stop: the clock stops for its time, held caster, any direct hit wakes it and deals wake_cut less). holds_caster: while it runs, its caster's arts with a damage part and basic attack do not fire (read live). timer_resisted: the target's timer_resist_pct shortens the time, at least 1 s; falloff: the delay falloff applies (delay_window). Slice 2b (2026-11-26): mod tick_to_heal (percent; filters element, status, dtype): a tick its holder takes deals nothing and heals that share of it (the Effects GDD's convert_tick_to_heal); a self-counter's upkeep {pool qi|hp, per_stack share of the pool's maximum}: paid each pulse per stack, unpaid stacks end (charges nearest their end first). Slice 2c (2026-11-26): action last_act_window {seconds, every, spend (a counter: one per round; empty ends it), hits [{c, dtype}]}: Down step 2 keeps the side in the fight for the window, untargetable, unhealable and out of its pulse; each round fires its hits as free hits; it ends Down on time or when the bank is empty; the foe going Down within it is a draw. Once a fight; a refusal comes first; it replaces the side's other last acts and its down event. Escape (world-depth Stage 5 slice E, 2026-11-26; Combat rule 10, Formulas I): an art with an `escape` value (e_art) opens a channel of escape_channel s when it fires (one per side; a ready escape art waits); when it ends, after both sides' hits in that instant and A first, a side above 0 health rolls p = clamp(e_art + escape_realm_step x (own realm - foe realm) - escape_lock_penalty x lock + escape/100, escape_min, escape_max), where lock is the foe's mod `lock` > 0 and `escape` the side's escape mod; Bound fails it with no draw. A success ends the fight: the fled side wins if the foe is at 0 or below, else the result is flight. A failure raises escape_failed. Slice 3 (2026-11-26): event qi_drained {amount} (burn_qi with to_self: that share of the linh luc burned moves to you); a leech heal's source is leech; readables own.lost_last.<hp|qi>.<seconds> (net losses per pulse over the window, plus since the last pulse; kept lost_last_keep s) and own.counter_hours.<id> / own.counter_this_hour.<id> (a charge counter's distinct fight hours, fight_hour s each, and the charges laid in the current hour; laid = end - each_for). Pill smoke (2026-11-26, user: smoke only for now): a build's pill {element, grade, fail}; action burn_pill {stacks_per_grade (4), for (6 s)} spends it once a fight: stacks_per_grade x grade debuff stacks of its element on the foe (Water as Ice, none as Wood), a fail roll when 0 < fail < 1, and the event pill_burned {element, grade, failed}. A burned pill gives its burner nothing until pills have fight effects. Slice 4 (2026-11-26): the Light element and damage type (light; Hán-Việt quang); a companion's tags ride on its hits' context (kind companion plus its tags: crane, bird); a debuff batch an art tagged talisman lays is marked talisman, and no cleanse removes it while its caster holds the mod talisman_fast (Rainfast Ink). Slice 5 (2026-11-26; Combat rule 25, Formulas L): each side keeps t_act (its last damaging or movement art, or evade) and t_move (its last movement art, tag movement, or evade). Readables own/foe.composed (a stance tagged composed, or composed_after s since t_act, from 0 at the start), composed_time, pressing (not composed, and a stance tagged pressing or pressing_after s since t_move), foe_pressed (the reader's foe acted within act_window s), since_act, field_up (the stance is tagged field), broken (the reader's foe has fallen to broken_threshold or below this fight) and wounded (the reader has). Events wounded (to the side that crossed) and broken (to its foe, with the crossing hit's art_id), once a fight, right after the hit, tick or pulse that crossed. REQUEST_TAGS (2026-11-26; Combat rules 12 and 26, AC-CB-104): the fight request's tags a fight keeps and rules may read, as tag.<name> (1 when the fight carries it); any other request tag (own_abode, vein, a biome or place) applies nothing and is noted once as ignored.
